cohort: The study included 78 preterm infants with a median gestational age of 27 weeks (<29 weeks GA) who were receiving nCPAP.
finding: HFNC was non-inferior to nCPAP in preterm infants as measured by dependent silent spaces (DSS), although infants who failed HFNC had higher DSS measurements suggesting decreased lung aeration.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken across four periods during nCPAP and a 6-hour HFNC intervention, and after returning to nCPAP.
